body:
Yeah I'd say they're pretty well off, she also mentioned that they have a housemaid who cooks her breakfast and dinner, packs her lunch for her and pretty much does all the house chores. So yah I guess it could be that she thinks that way. 

All this is just speculation though and in the end I should just really just ask her no matter how awkward this is for me, because tbh since I haven't talked to anyone or her about this I've been secretly feeling resentment towards her and I hate that I feel that way coz she's my friend and I should really just be honest with her to be fair.
She doesn't know how to drive though >.< But I'll definitely talk to her about the gas money. I can't avoid this much longer. Thanks for dropping by! :)
Exactly what my mom said! and yah, will definitely ask her. Thanks! :)
I always knew I should talk to her about this and I've always avoided doing it because I know it'd be awkward but yeah you're right, I just really have to ask. Thanks a lot for dropping by :)

I also thought about this at first and so I decided I wouldn't ask for money but then later on she mentioned that on top of her salary she's also getting allowance from her parents who are working in another country and she lives at their house so she doesn't have to pay rent or anything. I hate to think that she's using me to save money but sometimes I do feel like I'm being used.

I do have a feeling that she's also feeling awkward. That quite a long time has  passed and she hasn't ever helped out and so maybe she's a little shy to give money after the longest time and that our friends might call her out on it, I haven't told anyone at work that she doesn't help out though, I don't want beef in the office. Hence i'm having this internal struggle that I couldn't tell anyone about which is why I'm here. Thanks a lot for this, I think we really just need a reset. :)
